books_word_count_source_check.name: books_word_count_source_check
books_word_count_source_check.value:
("books"."word_count" IS NULL) = ("books"."word_count_source" IS NULL)
    AND ("books"."word_count_source" IS NULL OR "books"."word_count_source" IN ('stated', 'estimated'))

inbox_linked_resolved_check.name: inbox_linked_resolved_check
inbox_linked_resolved_check.value: ("inbox"."book_id" IS NULL AND "inbox"."run_id" IS NULL) OR "inbox"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL

issues_cover_date_source_check.name: issues_cover_date_source_check
issues_cover_date_source_check.value:
("issues"."cover_date" IS NULL) = ("issues"."cover_date_source" IS NULL)
    AND ("issues"."cover_date_source" IS NULL OR "issues"."cover_date_source" IN ('metron', 'hand'))

issues_story_title_source_check.name: issues_story_title_source_check
issues_story_title_source_check.value:
("issues"."story_title" IS NULL) = ("issues"."story_title_source" IS NULL)
    AND ("issues"."story_title_source" IS NULL OR "issues"."story_title_source" IN ('metron', 'hand'))
